title: LTO: 51 out of 52 buses in Metro Manila terminals pass roadworthiness

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Office (LTO) on Sunday said that 51 out of 52 in several terminals in Metro Manila passed the road worthiness inspections in preparation for the influx of passengers for Undas 2026. According to the LTO, roadworthiness inspections were held from Oct. 24-25, 2026. The LTO said that the 17 buses from the terminals of Santrans, Philippine Rabbit, Five Star, Sta. Lucia, Candon Bus Terminal, Bataan Transit, Genesis, Florida, and Dalin passed the test.
